name: Sentence too long for strict-plain

source.quote: Keep an instruction to 20 words and a description to 25. Code, paths, numbers with units and text in parentheses count as one word.

message: This sentence is longer than the strict-plain limit: 20 words for an instruction, 25 for a description. Long sentences are harder to follow and to translate.
fix: Split the sentence where a second idea or a second action starts, or cut words that carry no fact.

flag: Open the Settings page, select the Sync tab, choose the folder that you want to keep in sync with the server, and then select Save.
The connector keeps a local copy of every file that you change while the network is down and sends all of those changes to the server as soon as the connection is back.
pass: Open the Sync tab on the Settings page.
The connector keeps a local copy of each changed file while the network is down.
Run `demosync sync --all --verbose --retry 3 --timeout 30s --log-level debug` to sync every folder now.
On Windows, run the installer. The service then starts automatically at boot and runs as a service account that has read access to the synced folders only.

name: Paragraph has too many sentences

source.quote: Keep a paragraph to six sentences or fewer, about one topic.

message: This paragraph has more than six sentences. A reader who scans looks for one topic per paragraph.
fix: Split the paragraph where the topic changes, or turn a sequence of actions into a numbered list.

flag: The sync runs every hour. It sends your changes first. Then it gets the changes from the server. It compares the two sets. It keeps the newer copy. It writes a log entry for each conflict. You can read the log on the Activity page.
pass: The sync runs every hour. It sends your changes first, then gets the changes from the server. If both copies changed, it keeps the newer one.

name: More than one instruction in a sentence

source.section: Strict-plain overlay > One instruction per sentence
source.quote: Give one instruction in each sentence, so the reader can do one thing, check it, and go on.

message: This sentence gives more than one instruction. A reader who does one step at a time can miss the second one.
fix: Split it into one sentence or one numbered step for each action.

flag: Open the Settings page and select the Sync tab.
Select the file, then select Delete.
Sign in and open the dashboard.
pass: Press and hold the power button.
Drag and drop the file onto the window.
Select the files and folders that you want to share.
The service starts and stops on a schedule.
Select Save to close the dialog.

name: Condition after the instruction

source.quote: Put the condition before the instruction, so the reader knows whether the step applies before doing it.

message: The condition comes after the instruction. A reader can do the step before reading that it does not apply.
fix: Move the condition to the front: 'If the sync stops, restart the service.'

flag: Restart the service if the sync stops.
Select Retry when the network is back.
Do not close the window unless the upgrade has finished.
pass: If the sync stops, restart the service.
Select the date when the backup runs.
The sync stops if the disk is full.
